description: Canonical TMCP behavior atoms used to decide whether a node changes agent behavior enough to include in a compiled packet.

acceptance_criteria.description: Define explicit completion criteria before execution.

ambiguity_clarification.description: Resolve ambiguous user intent before risky execution.

approval_before_edit.description: Ask before editing when the request is exploratory or permission is uncertain.

approval_before_risk.description: Require explicit approval before destructive or high-risk actions.

avoid_speculative_abstraction.description: Avoid adding abstractions without demonstrated need.

bounded_change.description: Keep implementation scope tightly bounded to the request.

canonical_vocabulary.description: Use the project's canonical operating language.

change_execution.description: Make concrete code or artifact changes when intent is explicit.

citation_discipline.description: Keep research claims tied to reliable citations.

claim_evidence.description: Only claim completion with supporting verification evidence.

clear_closeout.description: Close with concise changed-work and verification status.

command_policy.description: Choose commands according to repo and sandbox policy.

conflict_branch_selection.description: Select the correct branch when instructions conflict.

context_selection.description: Load the smallest authoritative context packet for the task.

direct_execution_permission.description: Proceed directly when the user asks for implementation.

doc_staleness_check.description: Check whether durable docs are stale when documentation is in scope.

evidence_trace.description: Preserve traceable evidence for decisions and findings.

execution_ready_plan.description: Produce a plan specific enough to execute.

finding_evidence.description: Ground review findings in concrete files, lines, or runtime evidence.

minimal_context.description: Avoid loading broad context when narrow authoritative context is enough.

provenance_trace.description: Record where loaded behavior came from.

read_before_edit.description: Inspect relevant code or source material before modifying it.

reproduce_first.description: Reproduce a bug or failure before fixing it when feasible.

risk_review.description: Prioritize bugs, regressions, and missing tests in reviews.

root_cause_analysis.description: Explain why a failure happens before patching symptoms.

skill_routing.description: Route intent to the right skill or workflow surface.

source_grounding.description: Ground research or decisions in authoritative sources.

source_specific_behavior.description: Apply behavior that only exists in a precise source skill.

source_tier_precedence.description: Prefer higher-authority source tiers when behavior conflicts.

term_consistency.description: Keep names and concepts consistent with canonical language.

test_authoring.description: Add or update tests that match the changed behavior.

tool_safety.description: Use tools within sandbox, approval, and safety constraints.

ui_quality.description: Apply visual quality standards to UI work.

validation_reporting.description: Report validation commands, failures, and residual risk.

verification_gate.description: Run or justify the right verification before claiming completion.

visual_verification.description: Use rendered visual evidence for UI changes.

workflow_selection.description: Select the workflow that fits task intent and risk.
